_about: One simulated morning, replayed one check at a time by tests/simulate_morning.py. 'units' is what the fake API returns at that check (names from fake_units.json); 'expect' is the alert that check should trigger: new, updated, removed or nothing.

steps.what: Apt 5A is posted (over the test's rent limit: a normal alert)
5A still listed, same data - must NOT alert again
5A at the new rent, same as last check
API hiccup: 5A missing from one response
5A back on the next check - a blip, must NOT re-alert
5A still gone (30 s) - not yet a minute
5A gone for a minute - now confirmed removed, logged, no alert
5A re-listed AND 12C posted (12C is under the limit: an Emergency)
